name: capell-app/inertia-vue-adapter
description: Vue 3 client adapter for Capell Inertia pages, package routes, and adapter-driven themes.

healthChecks.label: Capell Inertia Vue adapter is registered.

marketplace.summary: Register the Vue 3 client runtime for Capell Inertia with Vue/Vite dependencies, a generic application entrypoint, and safe adapter activation.
marketplace.description: Registers Vue 3 NPM dependencies, the Capell Inertia Vue application entrypoint, and the vue adapter metadata consumed by the shared bridge. Choose it only when your frontend is built with Vue; it requires Capell Inertia and adds no screens to the admin.
marketplace.problem: Our Vue theme cannot use Capell pages until its client runtime is connected.
marketplace.outcome: A Vue Inertia theme can use the registered runtime to render public pages.

faq.question: Will editors change their content workflow?
faq.answer: Teams can choose a Vue Inertia theme without changing how editors manage Capell content.

faq.question: What does the Vue adapter provide to themes?
faq.answer: It registers the Vue client runtime and entrypoint used by Vue-based Inertia themes.

faq.question: Are there adapter settings in the admin?
faq.answer: The package declares no admin page or package settings.

screenshots.caption: Beta artwork for the Vue runtime adapter; rendered proof belongs to a consuming Vue page or theme.
